column3: “chews the cud” renders “brings up the cud” (also in verses 4–7).
“the rock badger” renders “shafan,” probably the hyrax.
The identification of the birds in verses 13–19 is uncertain.
“the ostrich” renders “the daughter of the ostrich.”
“the pelican” renders “qa’at,” a bird whose identity is uncertain.
The four Hebrew names for locusts are of uncertain identity.
“the mole” renders “holed,” probably the weasel; the identification of the creatures in verses 29–30 is uncertain.
“the crocodile” renders “koah,” perhaps a monitor lizard.
